scientific_question: On the already opened BLASTNet H2-air phi=0.5 S2 snapshot, does one fixed-linearization coarse-projected second curved residual-adjoint enrichment add complete-gate headroom beyond the current five-direction span?

frozen_parent_evidence.v44_role: provides the independently validated first coarse-resolvable curved-adjoint direction for an exact parity check; v51 independently regenerates and seals its coarse d5c
frozen_parent_evidence.v47_role: provides the current five-direction local mechanism baseline
frozen_parent_evidence.v50_role: independently replayed fixed roster found zero complete-gate witnesses among 2304 unique candidates on S2
frozen_parent_evidence.v49_role: inconclusive and forbidden as numeric evidence

stage_a_allowed_inputs: deployment-visible observation vector y for S2
v44 truth-free Stage-A S2 selected weights and candidate fields for parity only
stage_a_forbidden_inputs: v47 or v50 selected candidate weights
any fresh, stopping-validation or test payload

second_direction.first_curved_direction: independently regenerate and seal coarse d5c = normalized (I-Pi4) Gc P^T Gh J^T r0, then d5 = Gh P d5c; the high direction must match the validated v44 Stage-A d5
second_direction.coarse_restriction: P^T g1 followed by unweighted coarse gauge
second_direction.current_coarse_span: four frozen straight-CGLS increments plus the independently regenerated and sealed coarse d5c
second_direction.projection: individually normalize the five gauged coarse columns, then use a thin float64 SVD projection onto their orthogonal complement
second_direction.high_direction: d6 = normalized P times the orthogonal coarse component
second_direction.normalization: match the median positive high-resolution L2 norm of d1 through d5
second_direction.sign: positive d6 coefficient must have positive inner product with g1
second_direction.name: fixed-linearization coarse-projected second curved residual-adjoint enrichment
second_direction.interpretation: projected Gauss-Newton or augmented-Krylov-like direction only

arms: S5 padded control: d1 through d5 plus one exact zero-direction JVP per outer iteration
paired_stage_a_search.same_optimizer: frozen v44 exact-curved BVLS trust region
paired_stage_a_search.cost_padding: after each natural search terminates, repeat the final exact forward and zero-direction JVP only until both arms have exactly 9 F and 48 JVP; padding is included in wall time and cannot change candidate weights

stage_b_complete_gate.per_metric_compatibility: field, gradient and observation must each be <= 1.01 times Direct-K4
stage_b_complete_gate.zero_no_harm: field, gradient and observation must each be no worse than Zero
stage_b_complete_gate.direct_k3_observation_control: observation must be no worse than Direct-K3 plus 1e-12
stage_b_complete_gate.direct_k3_pareto_control: candidate must not be Pareto dominated by Direct-K3
stage_b_complete_gate.direction_attribution: S6 passes, S5 cost-padded control fails, abs(w6) > 1e-6, and the exact w6=0 ablation fails at least one complete-gate check
stage_b_complete_gate.fragile_witness_margin: a witness with less than 1e-3 margin to any 1.01 Direct-K4 metric gate is flagged fragile

decision_rules.mechanism_witness: all direction gates pass and the S6 direction-attribution gate passes
decision_rules.degenerate_direction: implementation and identities pass but out-of-span energy is below 0.05
decision_rules.degenerate_observation_tangent: field-space direction gates pass but Jd6 does not add the frozen observation-space energy/rank
decision_rules.bounded_negative: direction gates pass but S6 does not pass the complete attribution gate
decision_rules.inconclusive: any implementation, identity, parity, finite-value, ledger, Stage-A ordering or independent-replay check fails
decision_rules.after_one_S2_witness: freeze the unchanged method before running S1, S3 and S4; a witness closer than 1e-3 to any Direct-K4 compatibility boundary is fragile and does not authorize expansion; do not train a network yet
decision_rules.training_authorization: requires unchanged witnesses on all four opened snapshots and a separate learning contract

required_independent_validation: do not import the v51 runner
require a clean tracked worktree and independently recompute the source commit, four-file source closure, parent-evidence roster and Python/NumPy/PyTorch environment binding
independently regenerate and seal d5c from J^T r0, then verify high-direction parity to v44
independently recompute q5, alpha5, r1, g1 and d6
independently rerun both padded S5 and S6 searches
independently reconstruct all candidate fields and predictions
independently load truth only after validating Stage-A READY
independently recompute all metrics, gates, ledgers and final decision
